Verbatim, both utterances, in order:

> 10148 i18n-locale-en 天花板余量 不需要这是天花板余量

> 10148 不需要设置天花板余量

## What this seat reads it as, stated so a wrong reading is visible

**The EXHAUSTED-HEADROOM leg goes. The ceilings stay.**

- ⛔ OUT: the leg that fails a build because a ceiling has less than `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE` (0.10x) of one `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` left — and its companion `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES`, which exists only to hold debt against that floor.
- ✅ STAYS: `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES`, every `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` row (including `i18n-locale-en`), the entry budget, and the ceiling-freshness leg. ⇒ an actual regression that pushes a chunk **over** its ceiling still reds.

⚠️ The first utterance could also have been read as 「drop the `i18n-locale-en` row」. The second settles it: it is the **headroom setting** that is not wanted, ⛔ not that one row. This seat acted on the second, and records the first reading here so that if the intent was the narrower one, it is one sentence to say so.

## ⚠️ This ruling OVERTURNS text inside the gate itself, and that is the point

The failing job printed, and the script's own header carries:

> ⛔ Never lower `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE`, and ⛔ never add a row to `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_ALLOWANCES` to silence this

⭐ That prohibition was written for a **seat** reaching for the knob because a build went red — which is exactly what it should forbid. It is ⛔ not a bar on the maintainer, and the priority order says so: 「维护者裁决 > `AGENTS.md` > 红线 > 核心条款 > 细则 > 座位判断」. A gate-strength change is precisely the class that required this word, and it has it.

⇒ the implementing PR must **rewrite that prohibition to record this ruling**, ⛔ not delete it silently. A removed leg whose in-file warning still forbids removing it is how the next reader puts it back.

## Execution

`pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`, this seat. Dispatched immediately: this row is what holds the lane's landings, and PRs #10147 / #10149 / #10101 are parked behind it.

⛔ Not re-litigated, ⛔ not narrowed, ⛔ not traded for option C's measurement — the maintainer answered the question rather than the options, which outranks the options.

## ⭐ The decisive reading, and it is CI's own, not a local build

**`Bundle Analysis` on this PR: `completed: success`.**

And the dev's own measurement is the one that proves *why*: the **same** `eager-closure.json` (sha256 `440c84eb…`) weighed **twice in one command** —

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| `main`'s, blob read out of HEAD and printed equal to it | **exit 2**, reproducing the incident verbatim: 「1 ceiling is EXHAUSTED … `i18n-locale-en` 40.0 KB measured / 48.8 KB ceiling (headroom 8.8 KB = 0.10x)」 |
| this branch's | **exit 0**, all four per-chunk budgets green, and the `i18n-locale-en` row **still printed with its 8.8 KB / 0.10x headroom figure** |

⇒ the headroom is still *reported*; only *failing on it* is gone. That was the order's preferred shape and it was achievable.

## The pin discriminates by ONE BYTE

RED-before / GREEN-after in one command with the checker blob printed equal to HEAD in that same command:

- 「exits 0 when a chunk sits just **UNDER** its ceiling」 — FAILED before (`expected 2 to be +0`), passes after;
- 「still exits 1 when that same chunk goes **OVER** the same ceiling」 — **passed in BOTH**.

⭐ Same chunk, same ceiling, one byte apart. That is what separates 「the headroom leg went」 from 「the budget went」, and it is the control the order asked for.

⛔ **No ablation mutation, and the reason is right**: the before-leg is `main`'s own blob read out of HEAD into a temp dir, so the worktree was never mutated and there is no restore to prove. ⭐ Not performing a ritual ablation beats performing one.

## The enumeration came first, uncapped

**8** headroom-bearing identifiers, **94** occurrences, **9** files — counted before any row was read. **3 OUT** (`EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE` 11, `..._ALLOWANCES` 14, `..._ALLOWANCE_GRANULARITY_MULTIPLE` 8), **5 STAY**. ⇒ the order's 「⛔ do not cap your own output」 was obeyed, on a card filed by a seat that shipped exactly that error today.

## ⭐ The prohibition was REWRITTEN, and further than the order required

The order asked for the in-file 「⛔ Never lower `EXHAUSTED_HEADROOM_FLOOR_MULTIPLE`」 to record the ruling rather than vanish. It does — a `RETIRED` block carries what stood there, objectui#8554's argument as history, **the prohibition quoted intact**, the maintainer's two utterances **verbatim and untranslated**, and that re-adding the leg is a maintainer decision rather than a repair.

⭐ And it went further: **every cross-reference elsewhere in the file that argued FROM that floor was updated too** — the `framework` history note, the re-pin-sizing paragraph, and the `i18n-locale-en` row's own comment. Each now says the same thing in its own place: the tenth is a **CONVENTION for sizing a re-pin**, ⛔ not a line this gate enforces, and 「this row's ceiling is NOT touched by it」. ⇒ a reader arriving at any one of those four places learns the same fact. ⛔ A retirement recorded in one block and contradicted in three paragraphs is how it gets put back.

⚠️ The **BLIND** leg — a ceiling more than one whole regression ABOVE its payload — is untouched. ⭐ That is the opposite-direction guard, and keeping it is what makes this a retirement of one leg rather than of the sensitivity half.

## ⭐ The card's own unmeasured question is ANSWERED — and the answer was in the file all along

objectui#10148 said it did not know how close this row had been before today. The `i18n-locale-en` comment says: headroom **9,585 bytes = 0.11x**, 「just above the 0.10x … and the **first time this key has cleared it on the measurement alone**」.

⇒ the row was pinned at **0.11x by design at its last re-pin** — one small change from the floor, permanently. Today's +530 bytes took it from 0.11x to 0.10x. ⚠️ ⛔ **This is not「#10142 spent a large reserve」**: there was never a reserve. ⭐ That makes the ruling a coherent reading of the instrument rather than a way past a red — a floor a row sits one commit above is measuring the next change, which is the gate's own words for why the floor had to go.

## Landing — ⛔ HELD, and by this card's own rule

**12 of 39 checks are still pending** (the eight `Test` shards, now 1/8–8/8 since objectui#9584 landed).

⇒ ⛔ not flipping ready and ⛔ not arming auto-merge. This card's closing line is 「⛔ never arm auto-merge while any check is still pending — a PR is landed on conclusions, and an advisory red merges silently」, and the first PR that rule binds is the one that fixes the incident. ⭐ It will be landed when all 39 have reported, ⛔ not before.
